references.text: Joshua's death is also mentioned here, with the same age of 110 years, and he is called 'the servant of the Lord'
Joshua is appointed as Moses' successor and is later called 'the servant of the Lord' as here
Moses is called 'the servant of the Lord' at his death, the same title that Joshua receives here
Moses is called 'his servant', a precursor to the title 'the servant of the Lord' which Joshua inherits
At the beginning of the book, Joshua is called 'Moses' servant', and Moses is called 'the servant of the Lord'
Joseph also died at the age of 110 years, the same age as Joshua
Moses' age at his death (120 years) is compared with Joshua's age (110 years)
Stephen refers to Joshua (Jesus in Greek) who led the people into the land
Joshua is mentioned in connection with the fact that he did not give the people the final rest
